** sch_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-opamp_tb/export/root/opamp_tb.sch
**.subckt opamp_tb
XB1 in o1 ib buffer size=1
XB2 in o2 ib buffer size=2
XB3 in o3 ib buffer size=1
VVDD vdd! 0 dc 1.8
VVIN in 0 dc 0.9
**** begin user architecture code

.temp 27

**** end user architecture code
**.ends

* expanding   symbol:  root/buffer.sym # of pins=3
** sym_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-opamp_tb/export/root/buffer.sym
** sch_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-opamp_tb/export/root/buffer.sch
.subckt buffer IN OUT IB  size=1
*.ipin IN
*.opin OUT
*.ipin IB
X1 IN OUT OUT IB opamp wn='2*size' wp='4*size' l=0.5 cc=1p
.ends


* expanding   symbol:  root/opamp.sym # of pins=4
** sym_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-opamp_tb/export/root/opamp.sym
** sch_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-opamp_tb/export/root/opamp.sch
.subckt opamp INP INN OUT IBIAS  wn=2 wp=4 l=0.5 cc=1p
*.ipin INP
*.ipin INN
*.opin OUT
*.ipin IBIAS
MM1 n1 INP tail 0 nfet W='(wn)*1u' L='(l)*1u' nf=1 ad='((wn)*0.29)*1p'
MM2 n2 INN tail 0 nfet W='(wn)*1u' L='(l)*1u' nf=1 ad='((wn)*0.29)*1p'
MM3 n1 n1 vdd! vdd! pfet W='(wp)*1u' L='(l)*1u'
MM4 n2 n1 vdd! vdd! pfet W='(wp)*1u' L='(l)*1u'
MM5 tail IBIAS 0 0 nfet W='(wn*2)*1u' L='(l)*1u' nf=1 ad='((wn*2)*0.29)*1p'
MM6 OUT n2 vdd! vdd! pfet W='(wp*4)*1u' L='(l)*1u'
MM7 OUT IBIAS 0 0 nfet W='(wn*2)*1u' L='(l)*1u' nf=1 ad='((wn*2)*0.29)*1p'
MM8 IBIAS IBIAS 0 0 nfet W='(wn)*1u' L='(l)*1u' nf=1 ad='((wn)*0.29)*1p'
CCC n2 OUT 'cc'
.ends

.GLOBAL vdd!
.end
